ok.description: True when the adapter operation completed as designed. The remote command may still have a non-zero exit_code.

data.description: Operation-specific payload; null on failure unless partial data is useful.

session_create_failure.description: session.create that reached the host but did not return its full record: the candidate identity plus what is known about whether the remote created it.

session_ref.description: The session name or ID supplied by the caller. Optional for compatibility with earlier v1 records.
The session name or ID supplied by the caller. Optional for compatibility with earlier v1 records.

capture.description: Captured source-byte prefix rendered as UTF-8 with replacement for invalid byte sequences. bytes counts all observed source bytes, including bytes beyond the capture limit; truncated describes omitted source bytes, not UTF-8 rendering expansion. Human streams remain raw bytes.

capability_paths.description: Same keys as capabilities; the path this execution environment resolves the capability to, or null when it is missing.
